title: Beyond Expected Values: Risk-Sensitive Planning with Distributional Monte-Carlo Tree Search
abstract: arXiv:2610.23565v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Monte-Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) typically stores only scalar mean estimates, which makes it poorly suited for tail-risk objectives such as conditional value-at-risk (CVaR). We introduce Categorical Thompson Sampling with Optimism (CATSO) and Particle Thompson Sampling with Optimism (PATSO), two distributional MCTS algorithms that maintain finite-support empirical backup laws at Q-edges. CATSO represents Q-edge laws with categorical atoms and Dirichlet Thompson sampling, while PATSO represents them with adaptive particles. Both algorithms select actions using the CVaR of a Thompson-sampled Q-edge law plus a polynomial optimism bonus, and propagate scalar continuation values through visit-weighted averages of child Q-edge CVaR scores. For the finite-depth nested CVaR planning target, we prove an $O(n^{-1/2})$ bound on the root value error after $n$ rollouts, which upper-bounds the risk-sensitive simple regret. translated_title: 超越期望值：基于分布式蒙特卡洛树搜索的风险敏感规划
translated_abstract: 蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）通常只存储标量均值估计，这使其难以胜任诸如条件风险价值（CVaR）等尾部风险目标。我们提出了带乐观性的分类汤普森采样（CATSO）和带乐观性的粒子汤普森采样（PATSO），这是两种分布式MCTS算法，它们在Q边上维护有限支撑的经验备份分布。CATSO使用分类原子和狄利克雷汤普森采样来表示Q边分布，而PATSO则使用自适应粒子来表示。两种算法均利用汤普森采样的Q边分布的CVaR加上多项式乐观奖励来选择动作，并通过子节点Q边CVaR分数的访问加权平均来传播标量延续值。针对有限深度的嵌套CVaR规划目标，我们证明了在n次rollout后根节点值误差的O(n^{-1/2})界，该界同时上界了风险敏感的简单遗憾。CATSO增加了一个固定网格离散（此处原文被截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出了CATSO和PATSO两种分布式蒙特卡洛树搜索算法，通过在Q边维护完整的经验分布（而非仅存储均值估计）并结合CVaR与乐观奖励进行动作选择，实现了针对尾部风险的风险敏感规划，并证明了n次rollout后根节点值误差的O(n^{-1/2})理论界。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces CATSO and PATSO, two distributional MCTS algorithms that maintain full empirical distributions at Q-edges instead of scalar means, enabling risk-sensitive planning for CVaR objectives via Thompson sampling with optimism bonuses, and proves an O(n^{-1/2}) root value error bound.
